metadata.description: Risk level and message templates for command analysis

description.en: CRITICAL - Immediate data loss or system compromise
description.zh: 严重 - 可能导致数据丢失或系统受损
警告 - 可能影响系统安全
安全 - 未检测到风险

messages.en: This will delete all files on the system, causing complete data loss and system failure
messages.zh: 这将删除系统所有文件，导致数据完全丢失和系统无法启动

consequences.en: All data will be permanently destroyed, system will become unbootable
consequences.zh: 所有数据将被永久销毁，系统将无法启动

messages.en: This will delete your entire home directory and all personal files
messages.zh: 这将删除整个用户主目录和所有个人文件

consequences.en: All personal data, configurations, and documents will be permanently lost
consequences.zh: 所有个人数据、配置和文档将永久丢失

messages.en: Wildcard deletion may remove unexpected files including system files
messages.zh: 通配符删除可能意外删除包括系统文件在内的文件

consequences.en: Files matching the pattern will be permanently deleted, possibly including important files
consequences.zh: 匹配的文件将被永久删除，可能包括重要文件

messages.en: This will format the filesystem, destroying all data on the device
messages.zh: 这将格式化文件系统，销毁设备上的所有数据

consequences.en: All data on the target device will be permanently erased and unrecoverable
consequences.zh: 目标设备上的所有数据将被永久擦除且无法恢复

messages.en: Disk dump operation can overwrite critical system data or destroy partitions
messages.zh: 磁盘转储操作可能覆盖关键系统数据或破坏分区

consequences.en: Target device/partition data will be overwritten, potentially causing system corruption
consequences.zh: 目标设备/分区数据将被覆盖，可能导致系统损坏

messages.en: This will wipe filesystem signatures, making data recovery difficult
messages.zh: 这将清除文件系统签名，使数据恢复变得困难

consequences.en: Filesystem metadata will be destroyed, mounting and recovery will be extremely difficult
consequences.zh: 文件系统元数据将被销毁，挂载和恢复将极其困难

messages.en: Secure file deletion that permanently overwrites file contents
messages.zh: 安全文件删除，将永久覆盖文件内容

consequences.en: Files will be permanently overwritten and cannot be recovered by any means
consequences.zh: 文件将被永久覆盖，无法通过任何手段恢复

messages.en: Modifying OpenClaw authentication configuration may compromise security
messages.zh: 修改 OpenClaw 认证配置可能危及安全

consequences.en: Authentication tokens may be exposed, allowing unauthorized access
consequences.zh: 认证令牌可能暴露，导致未授权访问

messages.en: Modifying SSH configuration may allow unauthorized remote access
messages.zh: 修改 SSH 配置可能允许未授权的远程访问

consequences.en: Attackers may gain SSH access or modify trusted keys
consequences.zh: 攻击者可能获得 SSH 访问权限或修改受信任的密钥

messages.en: User account modification affects system authentication
messages.zh: 用户账户修改影响系统认证

consequences.en: May create backdoor accounts or modify existing user permissions
consequences.zh: 可能创建后门账户或修改现有用户权限

messages.en: cURL request contains authentication tokens that may leak sensitive data
messages.zh: cURL 请求包含认证令牌，可能泄露敏感数据

consequences.en: Authentication credentials may be logged by remote servers or intercepted
consequences.zh: 认证凭据可能被远程服务器记录或拦截

messages.en: Wget request contains authentication information
messages.zh: Wget 请求包含认证信息

consequences.en: Credentials may be visible in process list or logs
consequences.zh: 凭据可能在进程列表或日志中可见

messages.en: Reverse shell detected - this creates a remote control channel
messages.zh: 检测到反向 Shell - 这会创建远程控制通道

consequences.en: Attacker can execute arbitrary commands remotely with current user privileges
consequences.zh: 攻击者可以远程执行任意命令，拥有当前用户权限

messages.en: Data is being transferred to a remote host
messages.zh: 数据正被传输到远程主机

consequences.en: Data leaves local system - verify destination is trusted
consequences.zh: 数据离开本地系统 - 请确认目的地是可信的

messages.en: Command will execute with elevated privileges (root/admin)
messages.zh: 命令将以提升的权限（root/管理员）执行

consequences.en: Any errors or malicious commands will have system-wide impact
consequences.zh: 任何错误或恶意命令都将影响整个系统

messages.en: Switching to another user account
messages.zh: 正在切换到另一个用户账户

consequences.en: Operations will run with target user's permissions and environment
consequences.zh: 操作将以目标用户的权限和环境运行

messages.en: Container execution with potential filesystem and network access
messages.zh: 容器执行，可能访问文件系统和网络

consequences.en: Container may access host files if volumes mounted incorrectly; privileged mode is dangerous
consequences.zh: 如果卷挂载不正确，容器可能访问主机文件；特权模式是危险的

messages.en: Privileged container or root filesystem mount - complete host access
messages.zh: 特权容器或根文件系统挂载 - 完全访问主机

consequences.en: Container has full access to host devices and can modify host system
consequences.zh: 容器可以完全访问主机设备并可以修改主机系统

messages.en: Executing commands inside running container
messages.zh: 在运行中的容器内执行命令

consequences.en: Container state may be modified; potential escape vulnerabilities
consequences.zh: 容器状态可能被修改；存在逃逸漏洞风险

messages.en: Modifying firewall rules affects network connectivity and security
messages.zh: 修改防火墙规则影响网络连接和安全性

consequences.en: Incorrect rules may block legitimate traffic or expose services
consequences.zh: 错误的规则可能阻止合法流量或暴露服务

messages.en: Uncomplicated Firewall rule changes affect system security
messages.zh: Uncomplicated Firewall 规则更改影响系统安全

consequences.en: May accidentally block SSH access or open unnecessary ports
consequences.zh: 可能意外阻止 SSH 访问或打开不必要的端口

messages.en: Network interface configuration changes
messages.zh: 网络接口配置更改

consequences.en: May disrupt network connectivity or expose interfaces
consequences.zh: 可能中断网络连接或暴露接口

messages.en: System service modification affects system operation
messages.zh: 系统服务修改影响系统运行

consequences.en: Services may become unavailable; enable/disable affects boot behavior
consequences.zh: 服务可能变得不可用；启用/禁用影响启动行为

messages.en: Service control command execution
messages.zh: 服务控制命令执行

consequences.en: Affects running services and system stability
consequences.zh: 影响运行中的服务和系统稳定性

messages.en: Cron job modification - persistent scheduled task
messages.zh: Cron 任务修改 - 持久化定时任务

consequences.en: Scheduled tasks run automatically; verify command legitimacy
consequences.zh: 定时任务自动运行；请确认命令合法性

messages.en: System-level cron modification requires caution
messages.zh: 系统级 Cron 修改需要谨慎

consequences.en: May create persistent backdoor or scheduled malicious operations
consequences.zh: 可能创建持久化后门或定时恶意操作

messages.en: Downloading and immediately executing remote script is extremely dangerous
messages.zh: 下载并立即执行远程脚本极其危险

consequences.en: Remote server compromise or malicious code will execute immediately on your system
consequences.zh: 远程服务器被入侵或恶意代码将立即在您的系统上执行

messages.en: Base64 decoding followed by execution hides malicious commands
messages.zh: Base64 解码后执行可能隐藏恶意命令

consequences.en: Obfuscated commands may contain malware or backdoors
consequences.zh: 混淆的命令可能包含恶意软件或后门

messages.en: Evaluating dynamically constructed commands from network sources
messages.zh: 执行从网络源动态构建的命令

consequences.en: Arbitrary code execution with no control over what runs
consequences.zh: 任意代码执行，无法控制运行的内容

messages.en: Adding execute permission to files
messages.zh: 为文件添加执行权限

consequences.en: Files become executable; ensure source is trusted
consequences.zh: 文件变为可执行；请确保来源可信

messages.en: Recursive ownership change affects all files in directory
messages.zh: 递归所有权更改影响目录中的所有文件

consequences.en: May break system permissions if used on system directories
consequences.zh: 如果用于系统目录，可能破坏系统权限

messages.en: Directory listing - read-only operation
messages.zh: 目录列表 - 只读操作

consequences.en: No data modification, information disclosure only
consequences.zh: 不修改数据，仅披露信息

messages.en: File content viewing - read-only operation
messages.zh: 文件内容查看 - 只读操作

consequences.en: No data modification, information disclosure only
consequences.zh: 不修改数据，仅披露信息

messages.en: Text search - read-only operation
messages.zh: 文本搜索 - 只读操作

consequences.en: No data modification, information disclosure only
consequences.zh: 不修改数据，仅披露信息

messages.en: File search - read-only operation
messages.zh: 文件搜索 - 只读操作

consequences.en: No data modification, information disclosure only
consequences.zh: 不修改数据，仅披露信息

messages.en: Command risk level could not be determined - review manually
messages.zh: 无法确定命令风险等级 - 请手动审核

consequences.en: Unknown command behavior - proceed with caution
consequences.zh: 未知命令行为 - 请谨慎操作

messages.en: Error during risk analysis - command will be allowed
messages.zh: 风险分析过程中出错 - 命令将被允许

consequences.en: Risk analysis incomplete - user discretion advised
consequences.zh: 风险分析不完整 - 建议用户自行判断
